scripts.lint: eslint api/src api/tests api/prisma.config.ts client/src client/tests client/vite.config.ts shared eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.build: concurrently --success all --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix api run build" "npm --prefix client run build"
scripts.dev: concurrently --success all --kill-others --kill-signal SIGTERM "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently --success all --kill-others --kill-signal SIGTERM "npm --prefix api start" "npm --prefix client start"
